verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only inbound migration: exporting data from Carta or Pulley and importing it into Cake, plus spreadsheet bulk upload. Nothing documents exporting a full dataset out of Cake in open formats. The read-only MCP access and the live cap-table view are adjacent features, not a data-export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
